_note: Every string below is invented for this demo. No real person, patient, record, account or institution is described. Identifiers use reserved test ranges (555 phone prefix, example.com, 4111-test PAN).

examples.title: Clinical note
examples.blurb: Names, an MRN, a date, contact details and an address in one paragraph of free text.
examples.text:
Discharge summary — Patient Maria Alvarez, MRN: BWH-4482911, admitted to Mercy General Hospital in Denver on 03/14/2024 and discharged 03/19/2024.
Referring provider Dr. Peter Nakamura, NPI 1730495028. Contact the patient at maria.alvarez@example.com or (555) 234-9981.
SSN on file 412-88-7735. Mailing address 218 Larkspur Lane, Denver, 80218.
Follow-up scheduled with the cardiology clinic; records mirrored to https://portal.example.com/pt/4482911.

examples.title: Billing / support ticket
examples.blurb: Financial identifiers: card number, routing number, IBAN, plus a Canadian postal code.
examples.text:
Ticket #88213 opened by Jonas Whitfield, jonas.whitfield@example.com, phone +1 604 555 0142.
Card on file 4111 1111 1111 1111 was declined; customer asks to switch to ACH.
ABA routing 021000021. European subsidiary settles via IBAN DE89370400440532013000.
Billing address is in Vancouver, postal code V6B 2W9. Ticket raised 2024-11-02 from 203.0.113.44.

examples.title: Referral letter
examples.blurb: Mostly prose. Shows the statistical NER layer carrying the load where no regex fires.
examples.text:
Dear Dr. Amelia Rourke,

Thank you for seeing Thomas Beaumont, whom I referred from the Riverside Family Practice in Portland last month. He was previously under the care of St. Anne's Medical Centre in Halifax.

His employer, Northgate Logistics, has requested a fitness-for-duty note. Please copy me at c.mendez@example.com when the assessment is complete.

Kind regards,
Dr. Carla Mendez
